notes.title: All updates are complete!
notes.content:
[b][h1]After a long patch, One Drop is complete![/h1][/b]

As of today, you will be able to enjoy all the content within One Drop.
In the future, there will be no updates to proceed except for some story improvements and bug fixes.

[h3][b]UI/UX improvement [/b][/h3]

- The image in the text box shown in the NPC and Conversation has been modified.
- The image on the Tip has been modified slightly.
- The image in the menu has been modified.
- The image output when acquiring collection items scattered throughout the map has been modified.
- Fixed a phenomenon where some of the UIs did not close by clicking.
- The image on the clear screen has been modified.
- Cloud background added.
- The background color has been changed.
- Several environmental sounds have been added.
[u][b]- A mini-map has been added. [/b][/u]
[u][b]- Scoreboard added. [/b][/u]

[h3][b]Game play improvement[/b][/h3]

- I modified some of the difficult sections near the summit to make it easier to get there.
- The rocking legs are now more irregular and move more naturally.
[b][u]- The speed of movement on the ground has increased by 5%. [/u][/b]
[b][u]- You can fly without having to take your mouse to the center of the character anymore. [/u][/b]
[b][u]- Hard mode has been added. (However, you have to release the hard mode first to play it.)[/u][/b]

tags.bug: - Fixed a phenomenon where some of the UIs did not close by clicking.

tags.feature: - The background color has been changed.
- Several environmental sounds have been added.

tags.balance_change: - The speed of movement on the ground has increased by 5%.
- You can fly without having to take your mouse to the center of the character anymore.

tags.feature: - Hard mode has been added. (However, you have to release the hard mode first to play it.)

notes.title: Finally! a patch with collection items has been released!
notes.content:
Now, explore the map and collect items with stories!

A total of 27 items have been added, and more will be added along with the hard mode later.
Other than this, I fixed some bugs and UI.

tags.feature: A total of 27 items have been added, and more will be added along with the hard mode later.

tags.bug: I fixed some bugs and UI.

notes.title: 24-03-14 Patch Note
notes.content:
- I have addressed an issue where a green object exploding upon collision with a propeller was sporadically spawning in abnormal locations.
- Certain parts of the tutorial that were difficult to understand have been replaced with videos for a more intuitive experience.

Our upcoming discount event will commence shortly. I appreciate your interest.

* The collection part is still undergoing development. I kindly ask for your patience a little longer.
